custom.name: Custom WireGuard
custom.note: Import a standard WireGuard configuration from your provider.

mullvad.name: Mullvad
mullvad.note: Generate a WireGuard file in your account. Gluetun supplies the firewall; configuration hooks are not accepted.

protonvpn.name: Proton VPN
protonvpn.note: Download a WireGuard .conf file from your account. The guide includes free-plan limitations.

nordvpn.name: NordVPN
nordvpn.note: The guide covers manual WireGuard setup. This preview requires a standard .conf file, rather than app settings.

surfshark.name: Surfshark
surfshark.note: The manual setup guide explains how to generate keys and download a server configuration.

airvpn.name: AirVPN
airvpn.note: Sign in to the configuration generator and choose WireGuard.

ivpn.name: IVPN
ivpn.note: The WireGuard configuration generator is in the client area.

windscribe.name: Windscribe
windscribe.note: WireGuard configuration downloads require a paid account and are limited to locations included in your plan.

private internet access.name: Private Internet Access
private internet access.note: Manual WireGuard uses PIA’s official generation scripts. OpenVPN files cannot be imported into this preview.

cyberghost.name: CyberGhost
cyberghost.note: CyberGhost states that manual WireGuard configuration is not supported. Its OpenVPN setup needs an adapter that this preview does not yet include.

expressvpn.name: ExpressVPN
expressvpn.note: The official manual setup guides primarily cover OpenVPN. Those files are not accepted by this WireGuard-only preview.

ipvanish.name: IPVanish
ipvanish.note: Follow the account guide to generate a WireGuard configuration. Confirm that your plan supports configuration downloads.

privado.name: PrivadoVPN
privado.note: Manual configuration downloads require a Premium account. Choose WireGuard when generating the file.

privatevpn.name: PrivateVPN
privatevpn.note: Use the manual WireGuard section and generate a configuration in your account.

purevpn.name: PureVPN
purevpn.note: The manual guide explains how to download a WireGuard configuration from your account.

torguard.name: TorGuard
torguard.note: Generate a WireGuard configuration using the provider’s config generator.

vpnunlimited.name: VPN Unlimited
vpnunlimited.note: The guide covers generation of a WireGuard configuration from your User Office.

vyprvpn.name: VyprVPN
vyprvpn.note: These are general manual-connection guides. Verify that your account provides a standard WireGuard .conf; OpenVPN files are not accepted here.
